disposition_reason: The row clearly defines BlueField PCIe-interface GPUDirect traffic through NVQual Test #21. Stable endpoints/topology, GPUDirect memory-registration mode, traffic profile and signed performance/integrity limits are Project Configuration. They close the execution gate until supplied but do not require a new review decision or justify substituting ordinary NIC/PCIe traffic.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2140, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2141 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00018-V002 / 197f6adf13f7a48b was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the licensed pinned Test #21 module, GPU UUID/serial/BDF, NIC/DPU serial/port/BDF, traffic peer and complete PCIe/NUMA/IOMMU path.

Pin CUDA/driver/firmware/DOCA/MOFED compatibility, GPUDirect/memory-registration mode, direction, payload, queues/streams, concurrency, duration/repetitions and signed throughput/latency/loss/integrity limits.
Drain unrelated traffic and workloads, preserve/hash logs/topology/counters, and retain complete raw transfer, registration, buffer, integrity, PCIe, NIC, GPU, thermal and power evidence.
Demonstrate direct-path operation; CPU-staged transfer, ordinary NIC throughput or PCIe bandwidth cannot substitute. Retain the 60-minute source coverage.
Stop on data mismatch, excess loss, registration/buffer failure, path/link change, AER/NIC/GPU fault, thermal/power limit, hang/reboot or evidence gap; never reconfigure/reset or retry automatically.

test_case.test_name: Endpoint-and-direct-path-bound HGX NVQual Test #21 GPUDirect traffic
test_case.purpose: Exercise the exact GPU-to-BlueField/ConnectX GPUDirect data path with the approved traffic matrix and prove performance and data integrity without PCIe/NIC/GPU faults, unsafe resource pressure, hang or reboot.
required_package: Licensed pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #21 and compatible GPU/NIC/DPU/CUDA/driver/firmware/DOCA-MOFED stack
Signed GPU UUID/serial/BDF, NIC/DPU serial/port/BDF, peer and complete PCIe/NUMA/IOMMU path
Approved GPUDirect and memory-registration mode with proof against CPU-staged fallback
Dedicated drained SUT, trusted access, synchronized telemetry, thermal/power abort and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve/hash topology, registration, link, error and platform baselines and drain the authorized traffic scope. Run only the pinned Test #21 profile against the exact endpoints/path for 60 minutes; retain complete raw transfer, integrity, registration, buffer, performance and health evidence proving the direct path. Stop on first anomaly; do not alter IOMMU/driver/network policy, reset or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every signed transfer direction/profile uses the approved direct GPU-to-NIC/DPU path, meets throughput/latency/loss/data-integrity limits, preserves endpoint identities and link/function health, respects thermal/power limits, and completes all Test #21 items without hang or reboot.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until endpoint/path, stack/mode, traffic matrix and signed limits are bound. PASS requires complete accepted direct-path, integrity, performance and health evidence for every profile. FAIL on CPU-staged/wrong path, data mismatch, excess loss, threshold miss, registration/buffer failure, link/endpoint fault, thermal/power breach, hang/reboot or failed recovery. Missing inputs/artifacts are BLOCKED; aggregate vendor pass is insufficient.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until endpoints/path, compatible stack, direct-mode proof, traffic matrix, limits, isolation and recovery are signed.
Drain unrelated traffic/workloads and preserve baseline evidence before the saturating run.
Use an isolated SUT with stable cooling/power, BMC/console and explicit 60-minute traffic authorization.
Stop without reconfiguration, reset or automatic retry on first integrity, path or health anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #21 module/license/configuration and authorization
GPU and NIC/DPU stable identities, peer and complete PCIe/NUMA/IOMMU path plus compatible stack
Signed GPUDirect/registration mode, traffic matrix and quantitative acceptance contract
Complete raw throughput/latency/loss/data-integrity/registration/buffer results and direct-path proof with timestamps
First-fault recovery or clean final traffic/link/device state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong/fallback path, data mismatch, excess loss, registration/buffer failure, link/endpoint fault, thermal/power limit or evidence gap, terminate traffic and preserve first-fault artifacts. Do not change IOMMU/driver/network policy, reset or rerun automatically; follow signed owner recovery and quarantine if endpoint/path health is uncertain.
